shared_elements: human figures shown in profile/active poses
figures with drawn bows or projectile weapons
rows of small repeated strokes representing crew/soldiers or arrows
architectural or vehicle-like structures with crenellated/toothed upper edges (compare boats with rows of crew strokes)
justification: Both show human figures with bow- or spear-like weapons and rows of repeated short strokes above a long horizontal body (soldiers on battlements versus crew on boats), which is a superficial rather than specific correspondence. A depicts a coherent naturalistic siege scene with a fortified wall, towers, gate and a wheeled siege engine, while B is a scattered set of highly schematic stick figures, keeled boats with upturned prows and cup-mark dots, sharing no specific motif or relationship.
